patch_description: This implementation doubles the CRX ring entanglement layer while maintaining parameter efficiency through parameter sharing. The ansatz begins with independent RY rotations on all qubits, followed by two layers of ring-structured CRX gates where the second layer reuses the parameters of the first (crx_0 through crx_7). This increases entanglement depth without adding parameters, potentially improving expressivity and training convergence while maintaining the same number of parameters as the previous version. The final RZ layer provides additional local expressivity.
